summary.text: Tyreek Goodman, a Conservative Party candidate and Bronx resident, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 84 to Amanda Septimo.
He had run twice before without success, for this Assembly seat in 2024 and for New York City Council District 8 in 2025, and has not held elected office.

paragraphs.text: Goodman, a Bronx resident, told the Bronx Times that he was once disillusioned with politics and never saw himself running for office until fellow Conservative Gonzalo Duran challenged him to step up.
He ran for NY Assembly District 84 in 2024 on the Conservative Party line, finishing third with 2.9% of the vote behind Amanda Septimo (D/WFP) and Rosaline Nieves (R).

He announced a bid for New York City Council at a December 14, 2024 Bronx Conservative Party gathering, then ran for Council District 8 in the November 4, 2025 general election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines, finishing second with 12.0% of the vote (3,486 votes) behind Elsie Encarnacion.
The Bronx Conservative Party endorsed Goodman as its 2026 candidate for State Assembly District 84.
At the endorsement meeting he described a campaign concept called People Over Politics and said the party should educate voters about conservatism.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Goodman lost to Amanda Septimo, according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia.
